original: WPRPLACE (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈatnarˌstaːpɪ]) or Stapi is a small fishing and tourist village at the foot of Mt. Stapafell [ˈstaːpaˌfɛtl̥] between Hellnar village and Breiðavík [ˈpreiːðaˌviːk] farms on the southern side of Snæfellsnes, Iceland.
